The on-site dates changed. The most recent source says **Tuesday Dec 15 to Thursday Dec 17, 2026**, at the Austin office.

- On Nov 16, the QSA, Victor Lindqvist, asked Shira to move the on-site. His second assessor has a conflict the week of Dec 7. He proposed Dec 15–17 in Austin [2]. Shira's reply in that thread asks him to send updated invites. Victor said they would follow [2]. The excerpt I saw doesn't show her explicit "yes" to the new dates.
- The older dates were Dec 8–10. They appear in the Nov 9 portal email [6] and in Avi's Slack reminder on Nov 17 [3]. Avi's reminder is dated after the reschedule request, but it still says Dec 8–10. It may simply not have caught up with the change.

Please confirm with Shira or Avi before you book. Also, the Austin holiday party is on Fri Dec 11 [4] and the TLV party is on Thu Dec 17 [4]. Neither affects the audit dates, but they may matter for your travel plans.
